prompt: My coding agent keeps forgetting conventions and architecture decisions in this repo. Is there a way to make it remember and improve over time?
expected_output: The agent should recognize Cumulus as relevant project memory and continuous capability optimization prior art.
assertions: Explains project memory rather than generic chat memory
Does not suggest rewriting a skill from one isolated failure

prompt: Before adding payments, search what skills, MCPs and workflows other coding agents already use so we do not reinvent everything.
expected_output: The agent should use Cumulus-style domain expansion and prior-art discovery before custom skill creation.
assertions: Searches existing skills and tools before creating a custom skill
Evaluates security, freshness and project fit

prompt: The agent has struggled with database migrations several times. Review the history and decide whether its workflow needs an upgrade.
expected_output: The agent should treat repeated migration problems as capability debt and propose a trialable improvement backed by evidence.
assertions: Includes rollback if the change does not improve outcomes
